responsibility: This header provides the Linux-specific AArch64 target configuration used by GNU/Linux ports. It defines dynamic linker paths for glibc and musl, cc1 and linker spec fragments for PIE, static-pie, endianness, and ABI selection, integrates erratum linker options, installs Linux OS predefines and executable-stack handling, and enables Linux-specific policy such as static stack checking support and local-binding behavior for common symbols.
